newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall on poor foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall on poor foreign demand.

text.p: Poor demand from traditional buyers of Bangladeshi teas led to a price fall at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
They said buyers for Pakistan, Poland and Afghanistan were less active and lifted only small quantity of better liquoring teas.

Some 581,400 kg of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 52.97 taka per kg, 0.59 taka down from previous sale. The next auction will be held on February 18 with an expected offer of 980,000 kg.
